response.what_it_is: Diesel engine-powered feed pelletizer machine on a mobile cart
hidden_risks: Engine internal mechanical condition and compression
Actual feed pellet production throughput capacity (700kg/hr claim)
Condition of internal die and pressing rollers
Battery health and starter motor functionality
response.best_proof: Close-up photo of the engine nameplate and the internal pelletizer die chamber
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the industrial diesel engine and heavy flywheel setup for a car engine, or accepting unsupported production capacity claims.
